scenes.visual: extreme close-up of the black bristle brushes running along the steel side of a modern mall escalator, a white sneaker brushing against the bristles, subject in the lower half of the frame

narration.en: You've been using this escalator brush wrong your whole life.
narration.hi: Escalator pe ye brush dekha hai? Aap isse poori zindagi *galat* use kar rahe ho.

scenes.visual: a young man in an Indian shopping mall happily rubbing his shoe against the escalator side brushes, playful, lower half of frame

narration.en: Most people rub their shoes on it, like it's a free shoe polish.
narration.hi: Zyada tar log isse joote ragadte hain, jaise ye free ka *shoe polish* ho.

scenes.visual: macro view of the narrow gap between moving escalator steps and the shiny steel side panel, brushes running just above the gap, centered

narration.en: Its real name is a *skirt deflector*. It guards a tiny gap between the moving steps and the side wall.
narration.hi: Iska asli naam hai *skirt deflector*. Ye moving steps aur side wall ke beech ke chhote se gap ko guard karta hai.

scenes.visual: a loose shoelace and the end of a colourful dupatta dangerously close to the gap at the edge of an escalator step, tense dramatic lighting

narration.en: That gap can grab a shoelace, a dupatta, or a small finger, and pull it in.
narration.hi: Ye gap joote ki lace, dupatta, ya bachche ki ungli tak ko *kheench* sakta hai.

scenes.visual: a small child's colourful soft plastic clog on an escalator step near the side edge, busy Tokyo station in soft focus behind

narration.en: In Japan, shoes got stuck in escalators 65 times in just six months. About half were soft plastic shoes, often on small kids.
narration.hi: Japan mein sirf chhe mahine mein *65 baar* joote escalator mein phanse. Inmein se aadhe soft plastic wale joote the, aksar chhote bachchon ke.

scenes.visual: a happy Indian family standing safely in the middle of escalator steps holding the handrail, bright mall, warm light

narration.en: The bristles nudge your foot away from the edge. So stand in the middle, and never polish your shoes on it.
narration.hi: Ye brush aapke pair ko edge se door rakhta hai. Toh hamesha *beech mein* khade raho, aur isse joote mat chamkao.

scenes.visual: two young friends laughing in a mall, one showing his phone to the other, an escalator behind them

narration.en: Send this to the friend who still polishes his shoes on escalators.
narration.hi: Ye video us dost ko bhejo jo aaj bhi escalator pe joote chamkata hai.
